# Pharlux

> Pharlux is a single statically-linked Rust binary delivering unified OpenTelemetry-native observability (metrics, logs, and traces in V1.1) for small teams running 1-10 services on a single VPS. One binary, one `pharlux.toml`, one systemd unit — no external databases, no Docker, no multi-component stack. Dual-licensed: Community edition is free under AGPL-3.0; commercial licenses available for teams that cannot accept AGPL terms.

Pharlux is a product of Veltara Works. It targets teams currently running the Grafana + Prometheus + Loki stack who are frustrated with operating five moving parts to observe three services. The design philosophy is single-binary simplicity: storage is a custom write-ahead log plus per-signal Apache Parquet files queried through embedded Apache DataFusion. HTTP (Axum) and gRPC (Tonic) share one Tokio runtime.
